youtube.title: Import from YouTube
youtube.urlHint: After entering a link, the app detects the video's available subtitle tracks. You can select 1–2 tracks. Selecting two merges them into bilingual subtitles by timeline (the second track becomes the translation line); with one track you can choose to generate a Chinese translation with AI.

youtube.aiTranslate: Generate Chinese translation with AI (when no Chinese track)
youtube.aiTranslateHint: Enabling AI lets you translate a single subtitle track into Chinese automatically.

importLang.title: Select Learning Language
importLang.hint: For Japanese subtitles choose “Japanese”; the app will tokenize Japanese and extract readings and parts of speech. For English files choose “English”; the app will reduce word forms to their base lemma (e.g. went→go). For German files choose “German”; the app will lemmatize word forms (e.g. ging→gehen). For Chinese files choose “Chinese”; the app will segment Chinese and extract pinyin. Parsing won't start until a language is selected.
